dps_shared.translation: …and this practice of self-mortification, which is painful, ignoble, [and] unbeneficial.
dps_shared.example: yo c'āyaṃ attakilamath'ānuyogo dukkho anariyo anatthasañhito.

dps_last.example: ye te bhikkhū tiracchānakathikā kāyadaḷhibahulā viharanti tesam'pi ekajjhaṃ sen'āsanaṃ paññapeti, imāya'p'ime āyasmanto ratiyā acchissantī'ti.
